description: Scan a whole exchange for symbols matching technical conditions right now, and get the matches with the indicator values that matched. A screen is {"exchange","timeframe","groupLogicOperator":"AND"|"OR","groups":[{"logicOperator":"AND"|"OR","conditions":[{"id":"A","indicatorId":"rsi","params":{"period":14},"operator":"<","value":"30"}]}]}. Use list_indicators for indicator ids and their params. Operators: <, <=, >, >=, =, crosses_above, crosses_below. Optional per condition: "window":{"bars":3,"mode":"any"}, "barsAgo":1, "not":true, "timeframe":"4h". Optional top level: "barBasis":"closed"|"forming", "symbols":[...] (max 100; omit to scan the whole exchange).

barBasis.description: Evaluate on closed candles only (default) or include the forming one

exchange.description: Exchange to scan, e.g. binance, bybit, okx, mexc
